text:
carmen (growth): quick heads-up — noticed an uptick in leads sitting unowned for ~2m during enrichment spikes this morning. sample: 120 leads queued, 40 timed out on hs-enrich.
jon (revops): ugh. is the timeout on the enrichment webhook still 30s?
maria (marketing): yes, and enrichment service had a GC hiccup. leads fell back to default owner routing but our RR pool was empty so they went unclaimed.
kevin (salesops): can we set a short acceptance window to guarantee assignment before enrichment finishes? idea: give sales route 45s to claim, then fallback to overflow pool.
olivia (product): sounds reasonable. we should also distinguish between 'enrichment delayed' vs 'enrichment failed' — we only want to fallback when delayed > threshold, not on soft failures.
jon (revops): proposal: acceptance_window = 45s, enrichment_threshold = 60s, fallback_owner = overflow_pool, plus an immediate dead-letter to ops if >10 leads accumulate in 10m.
carmen (growth): agree. can we implement a soft-claim state so UI shows "pending-enrich" rather than unowned? less noisy for reps.
kevin (salesops): yes — sticky claim flag: when a rep clicks accept during pending-enrich, they keep ownership even if enrichment returns later. implement via claim_token on lead row.
hubspot-bot: webhook POST /lead/enrich returned 504 for 8 requests between 08:12-08:18.
maria (marketing): thanks bot. action item: roll out acceptance_window and fallback over weekend with canary 10% of traffic.
jon (revops): roll plan: 1) update HubSpot workflow: add condition "time_since_create > 45s" => route to overflow; 2) add fallback owner list (5 SDRs + overflow); 3) enable dead-letter metric in Datadog.
kevin (salesops): hubspot workflow snippet (pseudo):
```
if lead.created_at + 45s < now and enrichment.status != success:
  assign owner = round_robin(overflow_list)
  set lead.meta.claim_state = "pending-enrich"
else:
  continue normal rr
```
olivia (product): also add telemetry tag on the lead event: routing_reason = "enrich_timeout" so we can query MQL quality afterwards.
carmen (growth): can we also backfill owners for the 120 leads that timed out? quick script to assign to overflow and ping owners.
jon (revops): yes — I'll run a backfill job target=120 that assigns overflow and adds note "auto-assigned due to enrich timeout". will surface counts to #marketing after.
maria (marketing): timeline?
jon (revops): plan to ship canary Friday 14:00 UTC, monitor 4 hours, then full rollout Saturday 02:00 UTC. backfill run after full rollout.
kevin (salesops): put a short SOP in Confluence for reps: how to handle pending-enrich claims and how to return leads if quality is bad.
maria (marketing): I'll draft the SOP and the customer-facing FAQ snippet for sales leaders.
olivia (product): leaving a checklist: update HS workflow, enable claim_token, add telemetry, create Datadog alert (lead_dead_letter > 10 in 10m), backfill script, SOP.
carmen (growth): assigned: jon (revops) - infra + backfill, kevin (salesops) - claim UX + SOP, maria (marketing) - comms + FAQ, olivia (product) - telemetry + rollout signoff.
jon (revops): noted. will post canary results to #marketing after the 4h window.
kevin (salesops): :thumbsup: 
maria (marketing): thanks all — huge improvement if this removes the unowned spikes.
hubspot-bot: scheduled workflow update queued (change-id: wf-2023338).
